incidents.name: Carson token price manipulation
incidents.notes: The Carson token sizes its internal swap/reward from the pool reserves it reads, so a multi-pool flash loan moved that price and let the attacker withdraw the pool's USDT.

sources.ref: onchain review: Carson 0x0aCD5019EdC8ff765517e2e691C5EeF6f9c08830 created 2023-07-20T15:16:13Z by 0xebc30b1e38b1a34a801afe51bbef4e8be0b996e9, unrelated to attack sender 0x25bcbbb92c2ae9d0c6f4db814e46fd5c632e2bd3; no EIP-1967 Upgraded events, age measured from deployment. Loss verified onchain: 100,677.05 USDT left 0xe0a3e0f7e4c789747eb29a212ea915a7a1e1ac69 to the attacker in this transaction (DeFiHackLabs reports ~$150K across the incident). Boundary row: the victim behaved as coded and the attacker moved the price it read.
